|lore=Kadas’sa’Nikto. One of Jabba’s best pilots. Often pilots Jabba’s space yacht. '''Smuggler'''. Prefers to be flying combat starfighters.
|game_text=Adds 3 to power of anything he pilots. Once per turn while piloting Jabba’s Space Cruiser, you may ▼ Jabba aboard for free. Wooof may deploy with any cruiser via Combat Response. When deployed, you may take the top card of your Reserve Deck into hand.
|errata_history=Versions of [[Wooof (V)]] in [[Virtual Set 8: Jabba's Court]], in date order (2 versions). Slip texts are quoted as printed: ▼ and ▲ are the slips' arrow icons (deploy from / take into hand from Reserve Deck; reshuffle), and the immunity and pilot icons are the ones explained in each sheet's icon key (see [[Virtual card icons]]). Found while adding the original pre-Remaster slips (Bill, 12 November 2026).
* '''Original''' (this page): release sheet “Virtual Set #8” (Players Committee; released 24 November 2004; PDF dated 24 November 2004), page 3, slip 50 — [https://web.archive.org/web/20041205113015/http://www.swccgpc.com:80/Resources/VirtualSet8Final.pdf VirtualSet8Final.pdf on swccgpc.com] (Internet Archive capture of 5 December 2004), announced in the [https://web.archive.org/web/20041204170841/http://www.swccgpc.com/interior.htm Committee's news post of 24 November 2004]: “P 3. Once per turn while piloting Jabba’s Space Cruiser, you may ▼ Jabba aboard for free. Wooof may deploy with any cruiser via Combat Response. When deployed, you may take the top card of your Reserve Deck into hand.” Stats line: “POWER 2 ABILITY 2”. Deploy 2, forfeit 4. The slip is the old pre-template slip the Committee used before its December 2006 Remaster: the Decipher-style lower half with the slip mark “8•50” at bottom right and no expansion icon.
* '''PC-E1''' ([[Wooof (V) (Virtual Set 8) (Errata)]]): the Remaster sheet (official text as of 4 December 2006; [https://web.archive.org/web/20071026143738/http://www.swccgpc.com/Resources/VirtualCards8.pdf Internet Archive capture of 26 October 2007; later 2007 re-edits included], slip 50), in the Committee's Remaster template: “Adds 3 to power of anything he pilots. Wooof may deploy with any cruiser using Combat Response. When deployed, may draw top card from Reserve Deck. During your deploy phase, if piloting Jabba’s Space Cruiser, may deploy one Jabba aboard (for free) from Reserve Deck; reshuffle.” '''What changed:''' the Remaster rewrote the slip in the Committee's later wording (full text above; icons written out in words here). This is the current text of the Virtual Original card.
